Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Specifications of Heavy duty mixer grinder The Heavy-Duty Mixer Grinder (3 HP) is intended for grinding, pulverising and mixing various Ayurvedic ra w drugs, medicinal herbs, roots, bark, leaves, seeds and spices. It can be used for the preparation of coars e and fine powders (Churna), wet grinding and paste (Kalka) preparation. The equipment will facilitate effic ient, uniform and hygienic processing of raw materials in the Ayurvedic pharmacy. Specifications Motor capacity: 3 HP Power supply: 3 Phase Processing capacity: Approximately 3 kg per batch
